headline: EXO-KASE drops 'Waking Up The City' MV teaser
sub: Kai and Sehun's debut as a duo lands Dec 1 at 6 PM KST

points.title: What to know
items: EXO's newest unit after EXO-CBX and EXO-SC
SM calls it a 'visual performance unit'

source: Source: SM Entertainment (SMTOWN), via Korean media
caption:
EXO-KASE has dropped the MV teaser for 'Waking Up The City' ahead of their debut next week.

Kai and Sehun, EXO's 1994-born duo, release their 1st mini album 'Waking Up The City' on Dec 1 at 6 PM KST. The 7-track EP is led by the title track of the same name and includes one solo song from each member. SM Entertainment describes the pair as a 'visual performance unit', following EXO-CBX and EXO-SC.
